network.path: instance agent -> TCP b02-gateway4t4 -> Docker bridge -> tc HTB/bfifo -> dispatcher
network.rho_definition: offered state load / available signaling service budget
network.budget_rule: all non-Ideal policies use the same physical HTB parent rate B_s=offered/rho
network.tc: HTB parent with signaling class 1:10 and background class 1:20; bfifo queues; MTU 296

policies.FullSync: FIFO full event synchronization; no semantic suppression.
policies.RateFIFO: FIFO token bucket at the same physical B_s(t); no KV semantics.
policies.StaticSemantic: replacement + invalidation priority + replica cap two; no adaptive admission.
policies.Adaptive: StaticSemantic + EWMA delay/queue utility admission and dynamic global useful-prefix set.
policies.Ideal: Immediate state visibility upper bound; not deployable.

formal.request_generation: fixed-seed Zipf, byte-identical logical prompts across policies within rep

calibration.selection_rule: choose the candidate with the lowest mean normalized (p95 state age + view-missing) over rho 0.8,1.0,1.2; tie -> medium burst 4
